title: Applicationprocess accesses Dataobject
description: The workflow creates, reads, transforms or passes along the data object between steps as its input, intermediate state or result: a domain object that keeps its own state consistent (a value object or an aggregate held in memory), or data with no declared shape. Use accesses to a data-model object schema instead when the value is held to a declared shape: an interface, record, struct, dataclass or DTO of only fields, or a persisted entity.
x-dr-evidence: The process's step signatures or pipeline stage types take or return a domain object (a saga state or aggregate with methods on its own fields), or the steps pass an untyped context between them (a dict, a Map<string, unknown> or a parsed JSON value) that no interface, type or schema declares.
